simple.meaning: שָׂבַע (sâbaʻ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to sate , i.e. fill to satisfaction (literally or figuratively).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 97 times across Exodus, Leviticus, Deuteronomy, Ruth, 1 Chronicles, and 15 more, beginning at Exodus 16:8. Its contexts include land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׂבַע (H7646).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.short: to sate , i.e. fill to satisfaction (literally or figuratively)
definitions.usage: have enough, fill (full, self, with), be (to the) full (of), have plenty of, be satiate, satisfy (with), suffice, be weary of.

occurrences.englishText: Moses said, “Now Yahweh will give you meat to eat in the evening, and in the morning bread to satisfy you, because Yahweh hears your murmurings which you murmur against him. And who are we? Your murmurings are not against us, but against Yahweh.”

“I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel. Speak to them, saying, ‘At evening you shall eat meat, and in the morning you shall be filled with bread. Then you will know that I am Yahweh your God.’ ”
When I break your staff of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver your bread again by weight. You shall eat, and not be satisfied.
and houses full of all good things which you didn’t fill, and cisterns dug out which you didn’t dig, vineyards and olive trees which you didn’t plant, and you shall eat and be full;
You shall eat and be full, and you shall bless Yahweh your God for the good land which he has given you.
lest, when you have eaten and are full, and have built fine houses and lived in them;
I will give grass in your fields for your livestock, and you shall eat and be full.

The Levite, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you, as well as the foreigner living among you, the fatherless, and the widow who are within your gates shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied; that Yahweh your God may bless you in all the work of your hand which you do.

When you have finished tithing all the tithe of your increase in the third year, which is the year of tithing, then you shall give it to the Levite, to the foreigner, to the fatherless, and to the widow, that they may eat within your gates and be filled.

For when I have brought them into the land which I swore to their fathers, flowing with milk and honey, and they have eaten and filled themselves, and grown fat, then they will turn to other gods, and serve them, and despise me, and break my covenant.
At meal time Boaz said to her, “Come here, and eat some bread, and dip your morsel in the vinegar.”
Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
But Jehoiada grew old and was full of days, and he died. He was one hundred thirty years old when he died.

Azariah the chief priest, of the house of Zadok, answered him and said, “Since people began to bring the offerings into Yahweh’s house, we have eaten and had enough, and have plenty left over, for Yahweh has blessed his people; and that which is left is this great store.”

They took fortified cities and a rich land, and possessed houses full of all good things, cisterns dug out, vineyards, olive groves, and fruit trees in abundance. So they ate, were filled, became fat, and delighted themselves in your great goodness.
When I lie down, I say,
He will not allow me to catch my breath,
Why do you persecute me as God,
If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword.
if the men of my tent have not said,
to satisfy the waste and desolate ground,
from men by your hand, Yahweh,
As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness.
All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to Yahweh.
They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil.
But I will sing of your strength.
when I remember you on my bed,
By awesome deeds of righteousness, you answer us,
So they ate, and were well filled.
I am counted among those who go down into the pit.
Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness,
I will satisfy him with long life,
who satisfies your desire with good things,
He waters the mountains from his rooms.
Yahweh’s trees are well watered,
You give to them; they gather.
They asked, and he brought quails,
For he satisfies the longing soul.
Have mercy on us, Yahweh, have mercy on us,
Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease,
I will abundantly bless her provision.
You open your hand,
He makes peace in your borders.
Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way,
lest strangers feast on your wealth,
He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread,
A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth.
The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways;
A man’s stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth.
A man’s stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth.
Don’t love sleep, lest you come to poverty.
Have you found honey?
Let your foot be seldom in your neighbor’s house,
Sheol* Sheol is the place of the dead. and Abaddon are never satisfied;
Sheol* Sheol is the place of the dead. and Abaddon are never satisfied;
One who works his land will have an abundance of food;
One who works his land will have an abundance of food;
lest I be full, deny you, and say, ‘Who is Yahweh?’
“The leech has two daughters:
Sheol,* Sheol is the place of the dead.
For a servant when he is king,
All things are full of weariness beyond uttering. The eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.

There is one who is alone, and he has neither son nor brother. There is no end to all of his labor, neither are his eyes satisfied with wealth. “For whom then, do I labor and deprive my soul of enjoyment?” This also is vanity. Yes, it is a miserable business.
Moreover the profit of the earth is for all. The king profits from the field.

If a man fathers a hundred children, and lives many years, so that the days of his years are many, but his soul is not filled with good, and moreover he has no burial; I say, that a stillborn child is better than he:
“What are the multitude of your sacrifices to me?”, says Yahweh.
Through Yahweh of Armies’ wrath, the land is burned up;
He burns part of it in the fire.
After the suffering of his soul,
and if you pour out your soul to the hungry,
and Yahweh will guide you continually,
that you may nurse and be satisfied at the comforting breasts;

“How can I pardon you? Your children have forsaken me, and sworn by what are no gods. When I had fed them to the full, they committed adultery, and assembled themselves in troops at the prostitutes’ houses.
I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness,

But we will certainly perform every word that has gone out of our mouth, to burn incense to the queen of the sky, and to pour out drink offerings to her, as we have done, we and our fathers, our kings and our princes, in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem; for then had we plenty of food, and were well, and saw no evil.
For that day is of the Lord, Yahweh of Armies,
Chaldea will be a prey.
I will bring Israel again to his pasture,
He has filled me with bitterness.
Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him.
We have given our hands to the Egyptians,

They will cast their silver in the streets, and their gold will be as an unclean thing. Their silver and their gold won’t be able to deliver them in the day of Yahweh’s wrath. They won’t satisfy their souls or fill their bellies; because it has been the stumbling block of their iniquity.
You have played the prostitute also with the Assyrians, because you were insatiable; yes, you have played the prostitute with them, and yet you weren’t satisfied.
You have moreover multiplied your prostitution to the land of merchants, to Chaldea; and yet you weren’t satisfied with this.
When your wares went out of the seas,
I will leave you on the land.
You shall be filled at my table with horses and chariots, with mighty men, and with all men of war,” says the Lord Yahweh.’
They will eat, and not have enough.
According to their pasture, so were they filled;
According to their pasture, so were they filled;
Yahweh answered his people,
You will have plenty to eat, and be satisfied,
So two or three cities staggered to one city to drink water,
You shall eat, but not be satisfied.

Yes, moreover, wine is treacherous. An arrogant man who doesn’t stay at home, who enlarges his desire as Sheol,* Sheol is the place of the dead. and he is like death, and can’t be satisfied, but gathers to himself all nations, and heaps to himself all peoples.
You are filled with shame, and not glory. You will also drink, and be exposed! The cup of Yahweh’s right hand will come around to you, and disgrace will cover your glory.
